actors.name: Kettlewell Parish Council
actors.private_context: The council is a body of elected members. It must formally adopt the precept for the next financial year at its January meeting, as required by its standing orders. The council has a chairperson and a clerk. The meeting is scheduled for a date in January 2027.

shared_context: Kettlewell Parish Council is a local government body. Its standing orders require the council to formally adopt the precept for the next financial year at its January meeting. The precept is the amount of council tax the parish council will collect. The meeting is scheduled to occur before the hard cutoff date of 2027-01-21T22:00:00+00:00.

starting_events.description: The January meeting of Kettlewell Parish Council is scheduled to take place. The agenda includes the formal adoption of next year's precept.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Kettlewell Parish Council formally adopted next year's precept at its January meeting before the hard cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
